name: js_new_atom_len
prototype: JSAtom js_new_atom_len(JSContext *ctx, const char *str, size_t len)

ownership.argument: First half of the inlined property define: create the atom from a C name, then call the atom-plus-value define, then release with js_atom_unref.

provenance.source: Takes the context, the name pointer and the length; tries the fast numeric-key path and otherwise calls the atom table lookup 0xC2748DC (ctx+16 runtime, hash h = 263*h + byte masked 0x3FFFFFFF over the atom hash table at rt+36/rt+52) and the intern core 0xC294B50, converting the resulting string with 0xC275F30. Two call sites, both property-definition paths.
